# Portfolio Workspace Instructions

- This workspace's public portfolio app is built with Flutter and served as a Flutter web app.
- Keep the responsive portfolio sections in `lib/main.dart` and preserve semantic labels, keyboard-accessible controls, and reduced-motion support.
- Keep resume details accurate to the CV content supplied by the user; do not invent experience, dates, credentials, or contact information.
- Do not publish referee phone numbers; use a references-available-upon-request note.
- Run `flutter test` and `flutter build web --release` to verify changes.
